pending_gate.summary: Analysis for ecom-content-stack: the reported serviceErrors payload (ECS_40001 / Bad request to downstream service.) is defined and emitted by ContentStackExceptionHandler.defaultBadRequestError(). Graph + file search show the local profile’s content-stack-service and content-stack-entry-service default base URLs incorrectly end in /v3/test (other envs use /v3), which forces bad requests to ContentStack under local defaults. Scope fence: only those two defaults in application-local.yaml. No source fix yet — awaiting Gate 1 approval of bugfix.md.
